composition_subtypes.role: Enumerates all subsets using integer bitmask and checks validity via precomputed conflict masks to find maximum independent set.

payload.core_composition_summary: Bitmask-based complete search over all 2^n subsets to find maximum independent set.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates all possible subsets via bitmask enumeration, checking conflicts with precomputed bitmasks; no DP or additional mechanisms, just exhaustive search with bitwise operations.
